\chapter{Hazard register (extended version)}
\label{app:A}

Full version of the register summarised in Table~\ref{tab:4.1}. For each hazard it gives the severity (S), exposure (E) and controllability (C), the operational domains where it applies, its main operational consequence and the most likely root cause hypothesis.
